# Every mutating /api/v1 route (RENT-BE-001 §8b). The integration suite fails
# when a route below commits without its audit event — exactly one, or one or
# more for a route marked "+" (runs and actions that issue documents and
# e-mails) — when a refused call leaves an event, or when a mutating route of
# internal/httpapi is missing from this list.
PUT /me
POST /assets
PUT /assets/{id}
POST /tenants
PUT /tenants/{id}
POST /leases
PUT /leases/{id}
POST /leases/{id}/transitions
POST /leases/{id}/guarantees
PUT /guarantees/{id}
POST /leases/{id}/revision +
POST /billing/runs +
POST /billing/documents/{id}/cancel +
PUT /params/irl/{quarter}
PUT /params/{key}
POST /jobs/{name}/trigger +
POST /payments +
PUT /payments/{id}
POST /payments/{id}/matches
